findings.claim: 10-K 披露國際營運（含美國出口）占銷售逾半，關稅與其他貿易限制若升高，可能衝擊競爭地位與財務表現；美國對中國等國關稅已引發報復性關稅，公司稱可能有重大不利影響，且無法保證完全抵銷
findings.excerpt: Our international operations, including U.S. exports, represent more than half of the Company’s sales.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱美方持續對中國及其他國家商品加徵關稅並引發報復，公司已部署緩解策略，但不保證能完全抵銷
findings.excerpt: While we have deployed strategies to mitigate the impact of these dynamic trade policies, there is no assurance that we will be able to mitigate the full impact of all such tariffs, retaliatory tariffs or other trade policies that have or may develop in this rapidly changing environment.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明航太事業多項主要零組件與原料為單一或唯一來源採購，關稅與貿易障礙可能影響關鍵供應商
findings.excerpt: Many major components, product equipment items, and raw materials, particularly in Aerospace Technologies, are procured or subcontracted on a single or sole-source basis.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明俄烏衝突下美國與他國對俄、白俄實施制裁與出口管制，公司對俄方合約剩餘義務無法估計超出已提列準備的合理可能損失
findings.excerpt: Given the uncertainty inherent in our remaining obligations related to our contracts with Russian counterparties, we do not believe it is possible to develop estimates of reasonably possible loss in excess of current accruals for these matters.

findings.claim: 2026 年 Q1 10-Q 列出 2025 與 2026 年關稅、新貿易調查與談判造成市場波動，並提及關稅傳導增加供應鏈與成本壓力；摘錄未給中國專屬金額

note: 搜尋未找到 HON 被列入 Entity List 或 2026 年 Section 232 直接點名 HON 的來源；2025 年報導之 $5 億關稅影響與中國占 60–70% 屬舊資料，未納入 finding。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條
